note: Runtime (three.js, Y-up, metres) coordinates. The origin is the ground plane under the chassis centre, which is where ExpeditionScene puts the rover (r.y is the terrain height). Front is -Z. Wheel hubs, track, wheelbase and clearance follow ROVER in src/sim/expedition.js; verify-art holds the file to them. Bounds are derived: half the track plus half the 0.2 m wheel; half the wheelbase plus the 0.313 m rolling radius; the mast head's top at 1.76 m. The body hangs at its 0.46 m clearance from the ground, not from the hubs.
